statement: Build a single-file, mobile-friendly website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse and filter products, read the size guide, see new arrivals and the lookbook, find the shop, and place orders on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: natural, muted colours and refined typography.
Mobile first: works well on a 360px phone screen and on a 1280px desktop.
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step.
Only facts supplied by the Requester are shown; nothing is invented.
No stock images; photo spots are plain and empty.
rules: Use only the products, prices, sizes, timings, address, policy, reviews and delivery terms supplied by the Requester.
Every product and lookbook card shows a plain empty photo spot; no stock or external images.
Orders go through WhatsApp number +91 00000 11111; the shop phone +91 00000 22222 is shown separately.
done_when: The page title and header show 'Thread & Loom' and Pune, and the page says the shop sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.

Products can be browsed by four categories (Kurtas, Sarees, Shirts, Dupattas), and all 10 products appear with the supplied names and prices: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199; Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999; Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599; Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099.

A size filter (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL and Free size) and a price filter exist in the file and, when used, show only matching products, using the supplied sizes: Indigo block-print kurta S to XXL; Mustard handloom kurta S to XL; White chikankari kurta XS to XL; Khadi cotton shirt S to XXL; Linen-blend shirt M to XXL; all sarees and dupattas free size.
A size guide table shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
A New Arrivals section shows exactly: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
Every product has an order button that opens a WhatsApp link to 910000011111 with the product name in the pre-filled message.
A Lookbook section shows 3 outfits: Outfit 1 Indigo block-print kurta + Block-print dupatta; Outfit 2 Ikat handloom saree + Chanderi dupatta; Outfit 3 White chikankari kurta + Linen-blend shirt.
A visit section shows the address (18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005), the timings (11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday) and the shop phone +91 00000 22222.
The return and exchange policy says: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, and no returns on sale items; the delivery terms say: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above 2,999, pay on delivery.
Three customer reviews appear: 'Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly' - Meera K.; 'Fast delivery and lovely packing' - Arjun S.; 'My go-to for festive kurtas' - Priya D.
Every product card and lookbook card contains an empty photo spot, and the file contains no image URLs or stock photos.
The file has a mobile viewport tag and responsive styles, with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.
The file is one HTML file with no JavaScript errors and no broken in-page links.
visitor_needs: See styled outfits in a lookbook
Read the return and exchange policy
